title: AFOSI agent has crew sign non-disclosure agreement
place_text: Squadron commander's office, Malmstrom Air Force Base

tellings.quote: And by the way, he introduced me to a man from AFOSI, Air Force Office of Special Investigation.

plain: After the 1967 missile shutdown at Malmstrom Air Force Base, Robert Salas says, his squadron commander called him in and introduced him to a man from AFOSI, the Air Force Office of Special Investigations, the Air Force's own investigators, who had the crew sign a non-disclosure agreement. Salas, a former Air Force officer who was there, tells Michels this from his own memory. As he tells it, the people who saw it were told from the start to keep quiet.
